mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PLATFORM (platform_id, job_id, platform_name, deposit_name, settlement_cycle, is_active, settlement_day) VALUES (#{platformId}, #{jobId}, #{platformName}, #{depositName}, #{settlementCycle}, #{isActive}, #{settlementDay})
mapper.update: UPDATE PLATFORM SET platform_name = #{platformName}, deposit_name = #{depositName}, settlement_cycle = #{settlementCycle}, is_active = #{isActive}, settlement_day = #{settlementDay} WHERE platform_id = #{platformId}
